case.diagramStudent: Hybrid architecture: tabular features and a temporal adapter feed parallel CNN and BiLSTM branches, then softmax-gated fusion, a risk threshold, and support routing.
case.diagramRestaurant: Hybrid retrieval: BM25 lexical ranking and Sentence Transformer plus FAISS semantic ranking run in parallel, then merge through weighted reciprocal-rank fusion before sentiment analysis.
case.diagramFace: Attendance workflow: enrolled reference, webcam capture, detect and align, ArcFace embedding, cosine match, then check-in or check-out. Abstract symbols only; no real face is shown.
case.diagramFlight: Booking journey: search, flight selection, seat holding, passenger information, checkout validation, simulated payment, and e-ticket generation.
case.distinctDatasets: UCI and OULAD are distinct datasets and are not treated as equivalent.
case.livenessBanner: Liveness detection is bypassed and anti-spoofing is not active.
